premises.text: Most people rarely check bills and lose hundreds yearly to hidden charges, errors, forgotten subscriptions, scams, and fraud
premises.evidence_span: We almost never check our bills. And the sad truth is, it's not only hackers, but legitimate merchants that are taking advantage of us. So much so that the average American will lose over $300 this year to stuff we simply miss

premises.text: Banks catch only about a third of card fraud, leaving consumers to catch the rest
premises.evidence_span: Card fraud alone will cost consumers over $7 billion this year, and the banks will catch only a third of it. The rest is up to us

premises.text: Crowdsourced flags alert you when a charge on your bill was flagged by others
premises.evidence_span: get an alert any time a charge on your bill is flagged by anyone else out there on theirs

premises.text: After card registration, daily scans run 100+ automated tests and email when attention is required
premises.evidence_span: BillGuard will do a daily scan of your credit card activity and email you when your attention is required

premises.text: Better Than Free model: free primary-card protection, then $4/month premium for unlimited cards
premises.evidence_span: you can find out absolutely free with your primary card. When you're convinced and want to protect all the cards in your wallet, you can upgrade to our premium version for only $4 a month later this year

premises.text: Distribution via direct-to-consumer plus bank, identity-theft, and antivirus partnerships
premises.evidence_span: we're in talks with three of the top US banks to deliver BillGuard as a native part of their banking experience. And later this year, we'll make announcements with leading identity theft and antivirus companies for major distribution to their customers

value.text: Protect consumers' money by catching bad bill charges automatically
value.evidence_span: BillGuard is in the business of protecting your money
